adjudication.rationale: In handleCancelBooking.ts the code changed from a single calendar reference (`find`) to multiple (`filter`) and now iterates `for (const reference of bookingCalendarReference)`. In the recurring-delete branch (inside `if (bookingToDelete.eventType?.recurringEvent && bookingToDelete.recurringEventId && allRemainingBookings)`), the deletion logic ignores the current `reference` and instead loops over *all* `bookingToDelete.user.credentials.filter(..._calendar)` and *all* `updatedBookings`, pushing `calendar?.deleteEvent(...)` for each. Because this whole recurring-delete block now runs once per reference, it will repeat the same delete operations multiple times when there are multiple calendar references, causing duplicate `deleteEvent` calls.
